notes.title: Dev Log #6 (Build 0.0.6.3)
notes.notes:
It's been too long since the last Dev Log, clubbers!

I've been extremely busy getting the game ready for it's Early Access release and it's nearly there.

Some new features include:

[list]
[*] A working phone! The ability to make calls has been added to the game (still very much in beta). So far, only 1 call is available. I look forward to seeing what other functions (and fun) can be added to using this device.
[/list]

[list]
[*] 3rd-person position selector menu for intimacy events.  As you know, the game occurs in first-person viewing mode most of the time, including during the intimacy events. Now, the ability to not only view these events in 3rd person has been added, but also the ability to switch positions (and cameras) during these events in real-time is available (all while remaining in 3rd person).
[/list]

Everything else in the game is continuously improving (and will continue to do so long after the initial release). Background NPCs continue to be added and improved. Animations are continuously added and improved for these characters. The level design is effectively complete and polish will continue in this area for as long as the game is in development.

Atmospheric sound effects (cars and what not in the parking lot) have been added.

Boob physics have been added! (still in Beta)

I have started plotting the course for the next stage of the game and planning post-release updates.

The next big thing to work on will be a trailer for the game. I want to try to have it for the next Dev Log.

And, of course, everyone wants to know: "When is the release date?" and I unfortunately have to give the over-used response: "It's done when it's done." It might be in 4 weeks and it might be in 4 months. It will almost certainly not be less than that time frame and almost as likely not much more than that (if more).  

I'm also looking at a fun promotion that will be available for people who want to support and / or improve the game. More details on this later!

That's the news for today and see you at the next update.

notes.title: Dev Log #5 (Build 0.0.6.0)
notes.notes:
As promised on the Dec. 25th post, here is an update on the game dev progress.

About 50 new intimacy positions have been added, in various states of completion (about 10-12 will be complete and available at time of EA release) 

Improved the AI for our main NPC characters to make them feel more realistic. 

Also made some improvements to the background NPCs, allowing them to move around the club and "talk" to each other.  They will also use the bathroom when they need to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049290/c62beefcf0033ec440c4c2b0933fe7f21498befd.png[/img]

Overall, the game is looking and functioning better than I had originally planned. However, it's not quite ready for release yet. I still need to add more content, polish up some animations, and improve the dialogue.

If you have any ideas or storylines you might like to see in the game, now would be a good time to submit them.  There is a suggestion box in the discord for that [url=https://discord.com/channels/999495508236193864/999496872685207582]here[/url].  Or leave a comment on this news release.

On the bright side, the game is now in a good position to receive future updates with minimal issues. I can easily add new characters, clothing, animations, items, and more, or make improvements to existing content.

notes.title: Dev Log #4 (Build 0.0.5.6) The Big One
notes.notes:
The last couple of months have been really exciting from the development standpoint.  About 3 months ago, the game was effectively a first-person walking simulator.  You could walk around, open doors, maybe talk to one or two people and that was about it.  Now, the whole thing is actually starting to feel like a video game.  

[b]New developments:[/b]
Almost all of the functionality that needs to be in the game is now in the game, rough and unpolished though it may be.
A lot of content has been added since the last Dev Log.  Unfortunately, still not enough for initial release of Early Access.
Content and Story are probably at 6-8% complete.  I'm aiming for 15-20% for initial Early Access
Environmental design (of initially available areas) is now at 90-95% completion, minus polish which will continue after initial release.
The nightclub now has a security guard who patrols the club and hallways.  He will chase and ban the player from the club when the player is caught going something naughty.  Being banned ends the game.
Background NPCs are now being populated into the nightclub.
Most of the NPCs are static and will not move except for their idle animation.  Eventually, many will be given some basic AI where they will walk around and do various things.
This new functionality is likely to be added after initial release.
The player can now purchase drinks from the bar.  This function is still quite rough and needs more polish, expansion, and development.
A massive optimization has been performed, the game now runs much more smoothly.  Final optimization still ongoing.
An enhanced interaction menu has been created.  Most basic interactions with people and objects are initiated by pressing E or left-clicking.  Right clicking on an object will now allow you to interact with objects in other ways.  For example, if you are at a door and right click on it, the standard "Open" option will be available in this list.  If you have the key for the door, an unlock option will become available as well in this new menu.
All said, things are moving along fairly smoothly and consistently.

The current roadmap is as follows:
producing enough content for initial Early Access release.
content is: story, dialogue, events, and animations
implementing minimal functionality for all interactable objects
polishing and refining existing assets and functionality to prepare the game for release
adding and refining AI for the main NPC characters.

Thanks for following the development this far and see you in the next Dev Log.

Other Path Games

notes.title: Dev Log #3 (Build: 0.0.5.1)
notes.notes:
First of all, I want to thank everyone who is currently following the progress on this game and especially those who have wish listed it on Steam, especially with how little info about it has so far been released.  You are the fuel which propels further development.

Secondly, I want to assure those interested in this game that development is much further along than currently posted screenshots would suggest.  In fact, all posted screenshots are now obsolete and all displayed content has been significantly upgraded.

The current state of the game is this; the environment is now about 85-90% complete.  However, game content and story are only somewhere about 3-5% complete.  And while that number might seem small (and it is), I'm finding it easier to create content and story than designing an entire building (and area), and it's functionality.  I'm pretty confident about the current state and direction because initial release of base game will require nearly 100% of the environment finished, but considerably less story and content complete, as story and content will continue to be updated after Base Game release.

How much story and content will need to be completed before release is a difficult one to answer.  Mostly, I'll just play it by ear until I feel that players will have enough to explore and discover to justify it's initial cost.
